The exception happens because ServiceTopologyCallable gets access to the system cache that hasn't been started yet. The callable has to postpone its execution until the cache is up and ready.
item.summary: Ignite Services: ServiceTopologyCallable is executed before system cache is started

status.description: The issue is considered finished, the resolution is correct. Issues which are not closed can be reopened.

comments.comment:
vkulichenko, agoncharuk,

Please review the fix. The changes are minor and attached in the diff file.

BTW, will such a fix work for caches which have SYNC rebalance mode (like the utility cache)?

Denis,

I would prefer if we waited for the system cache asynchronously using holdcc and resumecc. Even though is not likely, we still may have some sort of deadlock due to blocking wait. What do you think?

agoncharuk, good point!

I've reimplemented the fix using continuation API. Also I decided to use a timeout avoiding indefinite waits. Please see updated patch file.

The pull-request has been created (https://github.com/apache/ignite/pull/862) as well but it contains much more changes. Checking on TC.
vkulichenko, it would be perfect if you find the time for review because I'm modifying the code that was originally written by you.
